part.text:
Fixed. In `tokio-util/src/time/delay_queue.rs`:

- `remove` (tokio-util/src/time/delay_queue.rs:998) now wakes the waker stored by `poll_expired` when the removal empties the queue, so a concurrently parked `poll_expired` re-polls and returns `Poll::Ready(None)`. This covers `try_remove` too since it delegates to `remove`.
- `clear` gets the same treatment (matches upstream).

Verified: `cargo test -p tokio-util --all-features` passes, including the failing `wake_after_remove_last` test (33/33 in `time_delay_queue.rs`) and all other suites with no regressions.
